status: PRE-REGISTERED (defined before any vNext training). H22 NOT implemented.

arms.B: selected modern recurrent mechanism (KDA; fallback GDN) -- pure recurrent stack
arms.C: B + periodic MLA/full attention at 3:1 (the selected core)
arms.D: C + bounded slots (ONLY if slots remain under consideration)
arms.HISTORICAL: current Phase-based best internal architecture -- NON-CANDIDATE reference only

matched_conditions.params: matched total (and active, for any MoE) parameter count across A-E
matched_conditions.tokens: matched training tokens (target ~15B, aligned with arXiv:2607.07953)
matched_conditions.optimizer: matched across arms; AdamW primary, Muon compared separately so optimizer gains are not attributed to architecture
matched_conditions.decode_check: assert true recurrent decode (no full-prefix replay) via state-size + logits-equivalence hook
matched_conditions.nxn_check: assert NO [.,N,N] tensor in any linear-only layer via forward hooks
matched_conditions.resource_measurement: prefill/decode throughput, peak memory, recurrent-state bytes recorded

T1_language_modeling.require: C (or B) achieves statistically meaningful improvement OR parity vs A and E (95% CI over >=5 seeds); no regression > noise

T2_long_range_single_key.require: C robust across >=5 seeds (mean and worst-seed both above chance+margin); NOT a 1/3-seed artifact

T3_multi_key_retrieval.require: C >= E within margin; degrade gracefully with distractors

T4_entity_attribute_binding.require: C materially > chance and > A across >=5 seeds (this is the capability Phase FAILED)

T5_source_attribution.require: D > C only if slots retained; slots-off causal drop >= predefined delta

T6_supersession.require: D correctly supersedes; erase/write-gate-off causal degradation demonstrated

T9_distractor_resistance.require: no collapse vs clean setting beyond predefined margin

T11_recurrent_state_stress.require: documented graceful degradation; bounded-state size confirmed constant in N

T_efficiency.metric: decode throughput, peak mem, state bytes
T_efficiency.require: C sub-quadratic decode; recurrent-state bytes constant in N; measured, not computed

hard_gates: statistically meaningful LM improvement OR parity vs baseline (>=5 seeds)
every claimed path shows causal ablation degradation (no decorative path)
NO N×N tensor in linear-only layers
bounded recurrent decode state (constant in N)
thresholds NOT reused from tiny synthetic runs without justification
notes: The HISTORICAL Phase arm's result must NOT affect packaging selection except as evidence the replacement must outperform or avoid its failure modes (no retrieval, decorative path, full-prefix replay decode).
